slack_thread.text: Incident: the release notifier posted twice to #C-STAGING. Intended operation_id is release-note-v42. Intended text: "Release v42 shipped to production." chat.postMessage returned an error after the client had already forwarded the request. A teammate retried the same operation_id. We now have two messages. Do not write to #C-RELEASES; the authorized destination is C-STAGING.

linear_issue.title: Release note must be posted exactly once per operation
linear_issue.description: Acceptance: destination C-STAGING; operation_id release-note-v42; body exactly 'Release v42 shipped to production.'; at most one message for that operation. If the write was dispatched and the ack was lost, do not send that operation_id again. If the adapter shows the request never left the client, send once. A later announcement with a new operation_id may reuse the same body. Empty history pages are not proof of absence after a dispatched write.

fault_label: author-prepared input-sensitivity. Injected transport. Not a live Slack outage.
